summary: Correctly fixes the n_jobs=1 vs n_jobs>1 discrepancy by generating per-run seeds once via random_state and feeding the same integer seeds to kmeans_single in both the serial and parallel paths, making results independent of n_jobs. Minimal, well-placed change consistent with the existing parallel branch.

issues.description: The exact n_jobs=1 output now changes (each run gets a distinct int seed instead of sharing the evolving RNG state), so users who pinned the old serial inertia/labels will see different-but-correct values. This is the intended bugfix behavior, not a true regression.
No inline comment explaining that seeds are now hoisted above the branch specifically to make serial and parallel runs deterministic/identical; a one-line note would aid future maintainers.
